autoclicker-fabric.gui.help.active:
§eEnables automatic input simulation§r for this mouse button or key.
Each game tick, the mod checks its internal flags and, if active, calls the corresponding key-press API.
autoclicker-fabric.gui.help.spamming:
§eClick§r — press + release within 1 tick. The key stays down for exactly one tick, then is released.
§eHold§r — key stays held for N ticks (set in Hold Time). The client sees this as a continuous hold — needed for bows, shields, and eating.
autoclicker-fabric.gui.help.cooldown:
§eCooldown§r — attack is sent only when attackStrengthScale == 1.0 (charge full). Speed setting is ignored; the mod waits for this event. Guarantees max damage per hit.
§eSpeed§r — attacks every N ticks regardless of charge. 0 = every tick.
autoclicker-fabric.gui.help.shield:
§eOn§r — before each attack, checks whether you are using a ShieldItem. If so, the attack is suppressed.
§eOff§r — shield state is not checked; attacks fire continuously.
autoclicker-fabric.gui.help.mob-mode:
§eMobs§r — before attacking, a ray-trace result is verified: target must be a LivingEntity, alive and attackable. Blocks are ignored.
§eAll§r — attacks whatever the crosshair hits, including blocks.
autoclicker-fabric.gui.help.spam-speed:
§eDelay between actions§r in game ticks.
The mod counts down an internal timer and triggers only when it reaches zero.
20 ticks = 1 second. 0 = maximum speed (every tick).
autoclicker-fabric.gui.help.hud-enabled: Shows the on-screen overlay: active buttons, combat statistics, and current mode summary.
autoclicker-fabric.gui.help.hud-location: Moves the HUD overlay to the chosen screen corner. X/Y coordinates are recalculated automatically for the current GUI scale.
autoclicker-fabric.gui.help.randomize:
§eAdds a random delay§r after each action.
A random value from 0 to Range ticks (uniform) or a Gaussian value (if Gaussian Random is on) is added to the base timer.
Makes the click pattern unpredictable to automated analysis.
autoclicker-fabric.gui.help.randomize-ra:
§eMaximum random addition§r in ticks.
Each trigger, a value in [0, Range] is added on top of the base Speed delay.
Example: Range = 5 means 0–5 extra ticks per click.
autoclicker-fabric.gui.help.skip-chance:
§eRandomly skips§r N%% of attacks.
Before each attack, a random integer 0–99 is rolled. If it is below the threshold, the attack is cancelled this tick.
15–25%% is a reasonable value for anti-cheat evasion.
autoclicker-fabric.gui.help.health-thres:
§eHP threshold§r — when your HP (as %% of max) drops below this value, the configured Low HP Action triggers.
0 = disabled.
autoclicker-fabric.gui.help.movement-mod:
§eOff§r — attacks are independent of movement.
§eOn§r — before each hit, horizontal velocity (delta X/Z) and sprint state are checked. If moving, the attack is paused.
Prevents detection by correlating clicks with movement packets.
autoclicker-fabric.gui.help.movement-del: Extra random delay (in ticks) applied while you are moving.
autoclicker-fabric.gui.help.hold-duratio:
§eHow many ticks§r to hold the button per cycle in Hold mode.
1 tick = 50ms. Hold Duration is capped at the Speed value (can't hold longer than one cycle).
autoclicker-fabric.gui.help.profile-info: Shows the active attack configuration on-screen: mode (Cooldown/Speed), randomization, mob mode, shield, and other active flags.
autoclicker-fabric.gui.help.stats-enable: Shows live combat stats in the HUD: §eKills§r (cumulative), §eDPS§r (damage over a ~15s sliding window), §eKPM§r (kills/min), §eSession Time§r, §eTPS§r (server), §ePing§r (RTT to server).
autoclicker-fabric.gui.profiles.title: §l⚙ Profiles
autoclicker-fabric.gui.help.rotation-pro:
§eOn§r — each tick, current yaw/pitch is compared to the previous tick. If the delta exceeds 2°, the attack is blocked for that tick.
§eOff§r — camera state is not checked.
Prevents detection patterns where clicks happen without camera movement.
autoclicker-fabric.gui.help.target-delay:
§eSimulates player reaction time when switching targets.§r
When the ray-trace switches to a new LivingEntity, a countdown timer starts. Attacks are blocked until it expires.
3–5 ticks is recommended for realism.
autoclicker-fabric.gui.help.entity-prote:
§eOn§r — two-phase server confirmation before each attack.
Phase 1: waits until the target's hurtTime becomes > 0 (server accepted the hit). Phase 2: waits until hurtTime returns to 0 (invulnerability lifted). Only then is the next attack packet sent.
Prevents double-kills and accidental armor-stand destruction during lag.
§eOff§r — attack packets are sent without waiting.

§eTimeout§r (seconds) for Srv. Confirm.
If hurtTime on the target does not change within this time, the lock is released and the next attack is permitted.
0 = default (10 seconds).
autoclicker-fabric.gui.help.tps-sync:
§eAutomatically scales all delays§r proportional to server TPS drop.
Multiplier = 20÷TPS. Speed, Randomize Range, and Sigma are all multiplied by this factor each time the timer is reset.
At TPS=10 all delays double. Prevents Packet Spam kicks.
autoclicker-fabric.gui.help.max-ping:
§eMax Ping§r (ms).
Before each attack, the mod reads the current RTT (measured via KeepAlive packets). If ping ≥ threshold, the attack is skipped this tick.
0 = disabled.
autoclicker-fabric.gui.help.min-tps:
§eMin TPS§r.
Before each attack, the TPS tracker value (rolling average of recent KeepAlive intervals) is checked. If TPS < threshold, the attack is skipped.
0 = disabled. Normal TPS = 20.
autoclicker-fabric.gui.help.title: §l§6⚡ Multi Clicker Manual
autoclicker-fabric.gui.help.manual_text:
§l§6⚡ BASICS:§r
§7Press §fO§7 for settings, §fI§7 to toggle on/off.

§l§b⚒ MODES (Click vs Hold):§r
§7- §fClick§7: Press+release in 1 tick.
§7- §fHold§7: Key held for N ticks (bows/shields/eating).

§l§a⚔ SPEED vs COOLDOWN:§r
§7- §fCooldown§7: Attacks when attackStrengthScale == 1.0 (max dmg).
§7- §fSpeed§7: Attacks every N ticks (0=every tick).

§l§c🛡 ANTI-CHEAT:§r
§e1. Randomize§r — Adds random delay [0..Range] to timer
§e2. Target Delay§r — Countdown on ray-trace target switch
§e3. Rotation§r — Block attack if yaw/pitch delta > 2°
§e4. Movement§r — Block attack on X/Z velocity detected

§l§d⚡ PROTECTION:§r
§e• Srv. Confirm§r — Waits hurtTime>0 then hurtTime==0 before next hit
§e• Max Ping§r — Skips attack if RTT exceeds limit
§e• Min TPS§r — Skips attack if server TPS below limit

§l§7📊 STATS:§r
§e• DPS§r — Real damage (~15s sliding window)
§e• KPM§r — Kills per minute
§e• Ping§r — RTT (ms) via KeepAlive packets
autoclicker-fabric.gui.help.preset-minin: §e⛏ Mining§r — Continuously holds LMB via internal API (takes priority over attack logic). Allows uninterrupted block breaking.
autoclicker-fabric.gui.help.preset-farm: §e🌾 Farm§r — Cooldown + Mob Mode + Random ±3 ticks
autoclicker-fabric.gui.help.gaussian-ran: §eGaussian Random§r — instead of uniform [0..Range], delay additions are drawn from a normal distribution (mean = 0, std dev = Sigma). Closer to natural human timing.
autoclicker-fabric.gui.help.random-sigma:
§eStandard deviation (Sigma)§r for Gaussian randomization.
Higher Sigma = wider spread of delays. With TPS Sync enabled, Sigma is also multiplied by (20÷TPS).
autoclicker-fabric.gui.help.anti-afk: §eAnti-AFK§r — when the player is fully idle for the configured interval, the mod performs a brief micro-action to update the server-side activity state.
autoclicker-fabric.gui.help.anti-afk-int:
§eIdle interval§r (ticks) before Anti-AFK fires.
The mod counts ticks without mouse movement or WASD input. Default: 200 ticks (10 seconds).
autoclicker-fabric.gui.help.anti-afk-mod:
§eShift§r — briefly presses Sneak for ~3 ticks and releases.
§eStep§r — holds W for ~3 ticks (STEPPING_MOVE), then holds S for ~3 ticks (STEPPING_RETURN). Server registers a micro-step forward and back.
autoclicker-fabric.gui.help.smart-trigge: §eCrowd Attack§r — before swinging, the mod builds an AABB expanded +2.5 blocks (X/Z) around the target and counts living, attackable entities inside. Attack fires only if the count meets the threshold.
§eMinimum mob count§r within ~2.5 blocks of the target to allow an attack.
autoclicker-fabric.gui.help.looting-swap: §eLooting Swapper§r — when the target's HP ≤ the best Looting sword's damage in inventory, the mod temporarily swaps to that sword, waits for a full attack charge, delivers the killing blow, then restores the original slot.
autoclicker-fabric.gui.help.low-hp-actio:
§eLow HP Action§r — each tick, (currentHP / maxHP × 100) is compared against the threshold.
§eStop§r — attacks are suppressed until HP recovers.
§eDisconnect§r — immediately severs the server connection.
autoclicker-fabric.gui.help.save-tool: §eSave-Tool§r — before each attack, reads remaining durability of the held item (maxDamage − damage). If it is at or below the threshold, all attacks and mining stop.
autoclicker-fabric.gui.help.save-tool-th: §eDurability threshold§r (in units) for Save-Tool. Clicking stops when durability reaches this value.
autoclicker-fabric.gui.help.auto-eat: §eAuto-Eat§r — when hunger level ≤ threshold, the mod first checks the offhand for food (uses it directly), otherwise searches the hotbar and swaps to the food slot. After saturation, the original slot is restored. All other clicker actions are paused while eating.
autoclicker-fabric.gui.help.auto-eat-thr: §eHunger threshold§r (0–20) that triggers Auto-Eat. Eating starts when foodLevel ≤ this value.
autoclicker-fabric.gui.help.trash-drop: §eSmart Drop§r — every ~0.5 seconds, the mod scans the full inventory and compares item IDs to the drop list. Matched items in the hotbar are dropped via the normal drop call; non-hotbar items are removed using an inventory THROW click.
autoclicker-fabric.gui.help.camera-lock: §eCamera Lock§r — intercepts mouse input via Mixin and zeroes out the rotation delta every tick, hard-locking Yaw and Pitch.
autoclicker-fabric.gui.help.auto-tool: §eAuto-Tool§r — each tick while the crosshair targets a block, the mod calculates destroySpeed for every hotbar item (including Efficiency bonus: level²+1). The slot with the highest value is selected automatically.
autoclicker-fabric.gui.help.afk-hologram: §eTarget ESP§r — renders a colored bounding box over the current clicker target via Level Renderer. Useful for visually confirming which entity the mod is attacking.
